swahost-dbg.description: Diagnostic only: final-hc on its log-only debug tree. c6f392a28b = PC3's PFXDBG admission log (53614116f3, on a0491db764) + full_kv (Full-layer prefix present on device or host before the SWA validator), session-instance hash, host/device free slots per pool, and counters of failed write-through backups and unbacked device evictions. Nothing reads the logged values. Run in a 28G scope.

swahost-r020.description: Pool-split lever L1: swahost-dbg with --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.2 (final-hc: 0.268). The device bytes are unchanged; device pools go from 160,395 full + 42,985 SWA to ~197K + ~39K tokens. --hicache-size 12 is split by device bytes, so the host pools go from 318K full (3.26 GB) + 85K SWA (8.74 GB) to ~392K + ~79K. Pool sizes only: per-token compute is unchanged.

swamargin-ctl.description: Exactness control for the SWA prefill window margin: final-mem-c1-c2a (no HiCache) on the margin tree d93fea83df (jumanzii/g4poc-swa-margin = a0491db764 + SGLANG_OPT_SWA_PREFILL_WINDOW_MARGIN) with the margin at 128.

swamargin-smallpool.description: Exactness candidate for the SWA prefill window margin: final-hc-smallpool (16K-token device pool, so later turns load back from the HiCache host pool) on the margin tree d93fea83df with the margin at 128. Control: swamargin-ctl. Run in a 28G scope.

swamargin-dbg.description: SWA prefill window margin lever, log-only tree: final-hc on 6cccdbe4e9 (jumanzii/g4poc-swa-margin-dbg = the margin commit d93fea83df + the PFXDBG admission log of c6f392a28b) with SGLANG_OPT_SWA_PREFILL_WINDOW_MARGIN=128 and G4POC_DEBUG_PREFIX_SPLIT=1. Run in a 28G scope.

swamargin-dbg-off.description: Same-tree control for swamargin-dbg: final-hc on 6cccdbe4e9 with the margin off (default 0) and G4POC_DEBUG_PREFIX_SPLIT=1; behaves as swahost-dbg (c6f392a28b). Run in a 28G scope.
